arStrings.szText: {c_important}Firewall's{/c} Size is increased by {c_number}[SF_11 * 100|%|]{/c} and duration increased to {c_number}[SF_10|1|]{/c} seconds.

{c_important}Firewall{/c} creates a ring of fire that deals {c_number}{dot:UPGRADEB_TOOLTIP_BURNING}{/c} Fire damage over {c_number}[SF_0|1|]{/c} seconds, but it now has a {c_number}[SF_28]{/c} second Cooldown.

Standing in this ring causes your Direct Damage to inflict this Burning damage to enemies.

{c_important}Firewall{/c} becomes a {c_important}Shock{/c} Skill, deals {c_number}{dot:UPGRADEC_SPARKING_TOOLTIP}{/c} Sparking damage over {c_number}[SF_0|1|]{/c} seconds, and costs {c_number}{SF_19}{/c} Mana.

{c_label}Lucky Hit:{/c} Up to a {c_number}[SF_18|%|]{/c} chance to deal {c_number}{payload:UPGRADEC_DAMAGE}{/c} damage and form a {u}{c_important}Crackling Energy{/c}{/u} against enemies affected by {c_important}Firewall{/c}.

{c_important}Firewall{/c} heals you for {c_number}[{SF_33}*100|1%|]{/c} of your Maximum Life {c_number}([PlayerHealthMax() * SF_33]){/c} every second per affected enemy.

Every {c_number}[{heal:UPGRADE1_HEAL_OVERPOWER_TOOLTIP}|0|]{/c} Life healed by {c_important}Firewall{/c} grants you {c_number}1{/c} stack of {u}{c_important}Overpower{/c}{/u}.
{c_important}Firewall{/c} deals {c_number}[{SF_29} * 100|%x|]{/c} increased damage, but its duration is reduced by {c_number}[{SF_30} * 100|%+|]{/c}.
Every {c_number}{SF_35}{/c} Mana spent makes your next {c_important}Firewall{/c} cost no Mana, stacking up to {c_number}{SF_36}{/c} total Mana.
